programme_name: UPC-wide QP (quadrimestre de primavera / spring semester) master's pre-enrolment mechanism
official_status: n/a — institutional mechanism, not a programme
spring_intake: YES — the mechanism exists UPC-wide, but it is NOT school-wide in application
start_date_verbatim: per al quadrimestre de primavera: de la 1a setmana d'octubre fins a la 1a setmana de desembre
intakes_per_year: 2 preinscripció windows UPC-wide (QT autumn / QP spring); which masters open in QP is decided per master by each school
other_intakes: QT autumn: preinscripció 1st week of January to mid-July; start September
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: UPC-wide framework window: first week of October to first week of December (schools set their own narrower periods inside it)
evidence_verbatim: EN (UPC central FAQ): 'The general pre-enrolment dates in the UPC's academic calendar are, for the autumn semester, from the first week in January until the middle of July and, for the spring semester, from the first week in October until the first week in December. Within these dates, the school or university research institute may establish its own pre-enrolment periods.' | CA (same FAQ): 'Les dates generals de la preinscripcio estan fixades a nivell general al calendari academic de la UPC i son, per al quadrimestre de tardor: de la 1a setmana de gener fins a mitjans de juliol. Per al quadrimestre de primavera: de la 1a setmana d'octubre fins a la 1a setmana de desembre.' | UPC academic regulation (SGA): 'En el cas dels masters amb matricula d'estudiants de nou ingres al quadrimestre de primavera, se'ls admetra definitivament si en data 28 de febrer han obtingut el titol de grau.' -- i.e. UPC's own normative explicitly contemplates NEW-ENTRY (nou ingres) students enrolling in the spring semester, not merely continuing students.
notes: VERDICT ON THE SWEEP'S CLAIM: the February (QP) entry is a GENUINE new-student cohort start, not a second-semester continuation and not a late round into the autumn cohort -- UPC's academic regulation uses the phrase 'matricula d'estudiants de nou ingres al quadrimestre de primavera' and schools publish separate Feb admission calendars, separate resolution dates and separate matricula days. HOWEVER the claim that UPC runs a 'school-wide February intake ... covering at least 10 official master universitario programmes including Artificial Intelligence, Ingenieria Informatica, Telecomunicaciones, Aplicaciones y Tecnologias para Internet and Tecnologias Avanzadas' is NOT SUPPORTED. QP admission is opened master-by-master by each school, and the schools that publish a Feb calendar name only a small subset. Also: the 'QT-September or QP-February' quote attributed in the sweep to FIB does NOT appear on FIB's pre-enrolment page; it is on the FOOT (Terrassa School of Optics and Optometry) page for the Master's degree in Optometry and Vision Sciences. FIB's own current pre-enrolment page publishes ONE admission calendar only, for a September start.

official_status: master universitario (official) — Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACION RENOVADA) — joint UPC/URV/UB
spring_intake: NO for external applicants (CONFLICT — see notes)
start_date_verbatim: per comencar en el quadrimestre de Tardor del curs 2026-2027 (per comencar al setembre 2026)
intakes_per_year: 1 admission round (Feb-May) for a September start; a February new-access ENROLMENT day exists but no February admission round
other_intakes: February new-access matricula 5 Feb 2026 (deferred/place-reserved entrants only, no separate preinscripcio)
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND — FIB publishes no February preinscripcio window
tuition_total_eur: non-EU non-resident: 45,00 EUR/credit 1st enrolment (2026-27 UPC rates); UPC estimate 4.600 EUR for a 90-ECTS non-qualifying master, 3.200 EUR for 60 ECTS — CONFLICT: UPC's own master's FAQ states 102,52 EUR/credit for non-EU non-residents
evidence_verbatim: FIB preinscripcio news, 05 Feb 2026: 'La FIB obre la preinscripcio als masters oficials de la facultat per comencar en el quadrimestre de Tardor del curs 2026-2027 (per comencar al setembre 2026).' -- the ONLY quarter FIB opens pre-enrolment for. FIB pre-enrolment page: 'Admission Calendar, September 2026. The admission period to start the Master programme in September 2026, is open from 25 February to 29 May 2026.' -- one calendar only, no QP/February round. BUT FIB spring-semester enrolment news (21 Jan 2026), section 'MATRICULA ESTUDIS DE MASTER / MEI, MAI, MIRI, MDS': 'La matricula es: Estudiantat ja matriculat en cursos anteriors: 3 de febrer de 2026 | Estudiantat de nou acces: 5 de febrer de 2026.' | LANGUAGE: Language: English (FIB programme page, 'General details / Language / English'). Duration: 'Three semesters - Full time. 90 ECTS. Face-to-face'.
notes: CONFLICT, resolved as follows. A February NEW-ACCESS ('nou acces') master's enrolment demonstrably happens at FIB -- 5 February 2026 for MEI/MAI/MIRI/MDS -- so a February cohort entry physically exists. However FIB publishes NO February preinscripcio round: its only admission window (25 Feb - 29 May) is explicitly 'per comencar en el quadrimestre de Tardor ... setembre'. The February new entrants are therefore candidates admitted through that same autumn-start round who defer/reserve their place (UPC allows 'reserva de placa' to start the following quadrimestre), plus UPC bachelor graduates who finish in the January/February term. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CANDIDATE: there is no route by which an external non-EU applicant applies in autumn 2027 and starts at FIB in February 2028. To reach a February 2028 FIB start you would still have to apply in the Feb-May 2027 window for a September 2027 start and then DELAY by five months -- the opposite of the seven-month acceleration the sweep claimed. NOT the finding it was reported to be.
